generated_text.overview: Project adafruit/Adafruit-E-Paper-Display-Breakout-PCBs Adafruit 2.13in Tri Color e Ink with EYESPI current is a KiCad project containing 105 extracted component records. The catalogue matcher linked 23 physical placements to OOMP parts.
design_notes: The extracted board outline is approximately 60.97 mm by 39.37 mm.
Placement data contains 45 front-side and 16 back-side components.
review_notes: 42 physical component records are not yet matched to an OOMP part.
The extractor reports 5 named-net comparisons that differ between schematic and PCB data.
